subject.title: [F10] openclaw.end_reason always empty on session.ended spans

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw.end_reason` terminal-session taxonomy, and should it be exported on trajectory `session.ended`, diagnostics-otel `openclaw.run`, or both?
rationale: Current main has no documented `openclaw.end_reason` contract, and the issue's requested enum would become an operator-facing telemetry surface that automation should not invent without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve a shared terminal-reason contract
options.body: Define the enum once, derive it from existing terminal signals, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

options.title: Scope it under the broader OTel issue
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102018 as the parent telemetry-contract item and resolve this focused request through that work.

options.title: Keep the current coarse fields
options.body: Decline a new attribute and document that supported consumers should use `status`, `openclaw.outcome`, and `openclaw.errorCategory`.

recommendation.title: Approve a shared terminal-reason contract
recommendation.body: Define the enum once, derive it from existing terminal signals, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent live signal on the same trajectory event-surface decision and related telemetry path.
